An '''adamant axe''' is the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] [[Tools#Axe|axe]], made by smithing a [[Diamond Axe|diamond axe]] with [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]]. It mines at speed 15 and has 5000 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/adamant_axe.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Smithing ===
{{Recipes}}

The upgrade uses no template: the template slot of the [[Smithing Table|smithing table]] is left empty.

Enchantments already on the base item are kept. Where the base and the new item share an enchantment, the higher level is used.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/process_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Loot ===
{{Sources}}

The loot table <code>matcha:equipment/adamant/axe</code> gives the item exactly as crafted; it is used by <code>/loot</code> and by the [[Updating items|item update system]].

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines axe blocks at speed 15.

The pack adds beds, candles, cactus and honeycomb blocks to the blocks axes mine quickly.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/axe.json}}</ref>

=== Combat ===

It deals 10 damage with an attack speed of 1.

=== Intrinsics ===

* [[Efficiency]] II
* {{G|Smelting}} Smelting: makes mined blocks drop their smelted form where the block's loot table supports it: ores drop ingots or [[Silver Bullion|silver bullion]], logs drop charcoal, sand drops glass and cobblestone drops stone.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/sand.json}}</ref>
* {{G|Weakness}} Weakness: gives the target Weakness II for 8 to 12 seconds on every hit, which feeds adamant armor's [[Doom]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/adamant_weapon.json}}</ref>
* [[Unbreaking]] II

The intrinsics are stored on the item and applied when it enters an inventory. See [[Adamant equipment]] for how the tier's intrinsics work together.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/intrinsic_enchants/apply_intrinsic_enchants.mcfunction}}</ref>

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Block of Diamond|blocks of diamond}} or [[Adamant Scrap|adamant scrap]]. Matcha Flavoured removes the repair cost limit, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting ingredient ===
In a [[Blast Furnace|blast furnace]], it smelts into one [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blast/netherite_ingot_from_blasting_netherite_materials.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
An apprentice-level [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] takes it in exchange for one [[Adamant Alloy|adamant alloy]], so the alloy can be reused.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/weaponsmith/2/netherite_axe.json}}</ref>

{{History line|1.03|The vanilla netherite recipes were blocked.}}
{{History line|1.10|Alloy equipment can be traded to a [[Weaponsmith|weaponsmith]] for its alloy, so players can rebuild old items with updated stats.}}
{{History line|1.12.1-alpha|Smithing no longer needs a base-metal ingot in the template slot; the slot is left empty. Smithing now keeps the enchantments already on the item. {{History line|1.12.2|Moved to the <code>matcha</code> namespace; older items can be updated with <code>/trigger update_item</code>. Adamant tools now smelt the blocks they mine.}}
